basic_info.description: This is an iconic, grand scale home by builder Charles Hinkel, located up the hill from the Castro near Liberty Street in Eureka Valley. You'll enter a splendid formal entry with a partially open staircase, into the bright living and dining rooms with elegant period trim, 2 decorative fireplaces, medallions and high ceilings. Enter the kitchen and breakfast area with new wood floors, a full suite of stainless appliances including gas range, dishwasher and beverage cooler. The 2.5 baths have been updated. On the upper level, 3 bedrooms: the primary runs across the front with gorgeous downtown views and ample closets, an ensuite bath with steam shower, towel heater and heated floors. Two bedrooms at the back of the upper level. The fenced rear yard is lush; a deck that spans the width of the yard and is wonderful for outdoor meals, relaxing and entertaining. On the garage level, there's ample open storage, a new w/d, space for a workshop and 1 car parking (and one on the pad in front). The front of the home has double-paned windows to reduce city noise, all new exterior paint, solar panels, new electrical, gas and water auto-shutoffs, new water heater. Expansion/development potential. 2 blocks to shopping, all forms of transit, and shuttle stops!
